feed.title: Hess Corporation stock joined Chevron in a USD 53 billion deal
feed.summary: Chevron completed its $53 billion acquisition of Hess Corporation on July 18, 2025, transforming Hess from an independent producer into a part of Chevron's global energy portfolio. The deal involved Chevron issuing 301.25 million shares and assuming $8.8 billion in Hess's debt. A key component of the acquisition was Hess's 30% interest in Guyana's Stabroek Block, a significant asset for Chevron's energy operations.

feed.title: A Canadian bank in London is quietly building its rates team with some big hires

feed.title: What Does NVIDIA Offer That Texas Instruments Does Not?
